meta.title: ERP Budget Fetch at Intake: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Verify that ERP Budget Fetch at Intake is unavailable on a Growth-plan tenant.
Verify that ERP Budget Fetch at Intake works on an Enterprise-plan tenant and that the fetched budget is shown to approvers.
Sign in as the Requester / End User on both plan tenants and compare the same intake flow.
Switch or configure tenants by Growth versus Enterprise plan; catalog tenant switching only supports specified company IDs and does not change plan settings.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that ERP Budget Fetch at Intake is unavailable on a Growth-plan tenant.; Verify that ERP Budget Fetch at Intake works on an Enterprise-plan tenant and that the fetched budget is shown to approvers.; Sign in as the Requester / End User on both plan tenants and compare the same intake flow.; Switch or configure tenants by Growth versus Enterprise plan; catalog tenant switching only supports specified company IDs and does not change plan settings.

args.need: provide or configure Growth-plan and Enterprise-plan tenants, sign in as the Requester / End User, run ERP Budget Fetch at Intake on both, and verify refusal or absence on Growth and successful budget retrieval shown to approvers on Enterprise

steps.note: The plan entitlement, ERP integration, requester authentication, and approver presentation are not observable through catalog steps.
Assert only that the resulting screen is not crashed or showing raw errors; this does not claim the ERP budget behavior was verified.
